lines.text: What's the difference between an LLM and an AI agent?
An LLM, a large language model, reads your words and writes words back.
Ask it to book dinner, and you get advice. Then it stops.
An AI agent wraps that same model in a system,
with tools it can use, memory, and a loop.
It thinks, takes an action, checks the result, and loops until the job is done.
Same request, given to an agent.
It remembers you love Italian, searches for open tables, and checks your calendar.
It asks before booking, then books it. Done.
So, an LLM answers questions. An agent completes tasks.
